name: session-guardian-statusbar
description: Shows Claude Code 5-hour + weekly usage in the VS Code status bar (companion to the Session Guardian Claude Code plugin).

sessionGuardian.warnPct.description: Color the status bar item at/above this %.

sessionGuardian.critPct.description: Error color + warning toast at/above this %.

sessionGuardian.refreshSeconds.description: How often to refresh the status bar from the cache.

sessionGuardian.ccusageFallback.description: When the plugin cache is missing/stale, run ccusage directly to estimate usage.
